'''Flux capacitor connectors''' were components in [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], devices which allowed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] for fast travel around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. If flux capacitor connectors broke during hyperspace travel, they could short out the hyperdrive and cause a starship to abruptly drop out of hyperspace.<ref name="Kira" /> Sometime between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]],<ref name="Kira-Date">{{WEGCite|story=The Package (adventure)|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}} places itself after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and during the [[New Republic era]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. ''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]'', which showcases the end of the New Republic, is dated to [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''. Therefore, "The Package" must take place between 4 and 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> en route to the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony [[Lohopa II]] for a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation, a group of adventurers aboard a ship found themselves stuck in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] after their ship's flux capacitor connectors snapped. The crew was able to make repairs to continue on their journey.<ref name="Kira" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flux capacitor connectors appeared in "[[The Package (adventure)|The Package]]," a mini adventure published in [[West End Games]]' [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']] supplement for their ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', published in [[1993]].<ref name="Kira" /> The device shares its name with the [[w:c:futurepedia:Flux capacitor|flux capacitor]] from the [[Wikipedia:Back to the Future (franchise)|''Back to the Future'' franchise]].<ref name="BTTF">{{VisualMediaCite|title=[[Wikipedia:Back to the Future (film)|''Back to the Future'']]|director=[[Wikipedia:Robert Zemeckis|Robert Zemeckis]]|prod=[[Wikipedia:Amblin Entertainment|Amblin Entertainment]]|year=[[1985]]}}</ref>
